Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change,
with reported head impact and subsequent symptoms consistent with concussion. The
mechanism and force of the crash align well with the injury described. Neurological
examination and imaging findings clearly supoprt the diagnosis. There is no record of
prior injury to the head or neck region. Care was delivered over twenty visits and
followed a typical course of concussion management, including symptom monitoring,
cognitive and vestibular assessment, graded activity guidance, and gradual return to
daily functioning. Visit frequency tapered as symptoms resolved and the patient
reached functional recovery. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges
for each service rendered. Ongoing precautions were discussed, and the patient was
advised to report any recurrence of headache, dizziness, or cognitive difficulty.
